title_lines: 高铁事故改写选战议题

subtitles.en: The Spanish Prime Minister, Pedro Sanchez, has called a snap election after Parliament rejected his housing plan that was meant to quell protests across the region.
subtitles.zh: 西班牙首相佩德罗·桑切斯在议会否决其住房计划后宣布提前大选，该计划旨在平息各地抗议。

subtitles.en: When the train accident happened, obviously, this changed the whole strategy.
subtitles.zh: 火车事故发生后，显然改变了整个策略。

subtitles.en: The high-speed rail collision near Erda in the province of Toledo, on October 28, killed 69 people.
subtitles.zh: 10月28日，托莱多省埃尔达附近的高铁相撞事故造成69人死亡。

subtitles.en: It was a major, major blow for the socialist party.
subtitles.zh: 这对社会党是一次重大打击。

subtitles.en: The political responsibilities are not optional, they are essential.
subtitles.zh: 政治责任不是可选项，而是必不可少的。

subtitles.en: This story is all about Sanchez fighting to stay in power after eight years, and the possibility that not only will the Conservatives win,
subtitles.zh: 这个故事讲的是桑切斯在八年后为保住权力而战，以及不仅保守党可能获胜，

subtitles.en: but that the far right will have a lot of leverage over the government.
subtitles.zh: 而且极右翼将对政府拥有很大影响力。

subtitles.en: Could the Toledo train crash flip the Spanish boats? Pedro Sanchez has been struggling in polls. He's been really weak.
subtitles.zh: 托莱多火车事故会改变西班牙的选情吗？桑切斯在民调中一直挣扎，他真的很弱。

subtitles.en: He saw an opportunity there to jump in and call a snap election, in which he could present himself as the person trying to solve the crisis,
subtitles.zh: 他看到了一个机会，跳出来呼吁提前大选，在其中他可以把自己塑造成试图解决压力的人，

subtitles.en: and the person who had solutions, which he says the right will not have.
subtitles.zh: 以及拥有解决方案的人，他说右翼没有这些方案。

subtitles.en: Then everything changed. A high-speed rail service has slammed into another train about 60 miles south of Madrid in Spain.
subtitles.zh: 然后一切变了。一列高铁在西班牙马德里以南约60英里处撞上了另一列火车。

subtitles.en: Early findings point to technical failure and human error, but when officials singled out an individual worker,
subtitles.zh: 初步发现指向技术故障和人为失误，但当官员单独指出一名工人时，

title_refine.style: factual clickbait for China finance audience

entities.evidence: Multiple Chinese-language outlets (腾讯新闻, 中华时报, RFI中文) use 桑切斯 / 佩德罗·桑切斯 for Spain's PM.
Spanish-language sources confirm PSOE as Sánchez's socialist party; Chinese rendering 工人社会党 is standard but not directly co-occurring in the returned snippets.
Chinese outlets consistently render Toledo as 托莱多 in the train-crash context.

entities.common_zh: 西班牙托莱多高铁相撞事故
entities.preferred_zh: 西班牙托莱多高铁相撞事故
entities.evidence: Chinese media describe the event as 托莱多高铁相撞/追尾事故; 'Erda' has no established Chinese rendering in snippets.
Spanish sources identify PP as the conservative opposition; Chinese rendering 人民党 is standard but not directly co-occurring in snippets.
Infobae names Vox among parties rejecting housing decrees; Chinese rendering 呼声党 not confirmed in returned snippets, so title_label uses generic 极右翼.

terms.sense: early general election called before the end of the term

clip_research.source_claim: The Spanish Prime Minister, Pedro Sanchez, has called a snap election after Parliament rejected his housing plan that was meant to quell protests across the region.
clip_research.public_baseline: Multiple Spanish-language outlets report Sánchez announced early general elections for November 29 after Parliament rejected two housing decrees, following protests over an eviction.

evidence.fact: Sánchez called a snap election after Parliament rejected his housing plan.

evidence.query: Pedro Sánchez elecciones generales adelanto 2025 plan vivienda Parlamento
evidence.fact: AP reports Sánchez announced early elections in November after housing decrees were rejected.

evidence.query: Pedro Sánchez elecciones generales adelanto 2025 plan vivienda Parlamento
evidence.fact: Telemundo reports dissolution of Parliament and early elections on Nov 29 after housing decree defeat.

forbidden_claims: Claiming the train crash caused the election call (the transcript says the crash changed strategy, not that it triggered the election).
Stating an exact death toll as universally confirmed; sources vary between 46, 68 and 69.
Asserting the far right will enter government; the transcript only says it could have leverage.

notes: Death toll for the Toledo crash varies across sources (46/68/69); avoid a single hard number in titles unless sourced to one outlet.
The transcript's 'Erda' has no established Chinese rendering in the returned snippets; use 托莱多 instead.
Vox's Chinese name 呼声党 is not confirmed by the returned snippets; keep title_label generic (极右翼).

data_driven_lessons.source: KC桌面-视频号动态数据明细.csv, 114 rows, July 2026 local analysis
winning_patterns: 机构/人物权威 + 具体数字/资产 + 强问题，例如 高盛王逸：4-5万亿城市更新会拖住楼市吗
大机构/名人 + 被逼/陷阱/真相/转向 等张力词，例如 野村辜朝明：日本央行被逼到墙角
具体数据 + 政策动作疑问，例如 6月PMI释放积极信号，政府会加码吗
反常识判断 + 下一步条件，例如 低估值可能是价值陷阱，需等待政策转向消费
中国相关议题更容易获得点击，但表达要落在政策、需求、信心、估值、产业升级这些正向框架
外资或海外权威给出对中国更积极的判断时，反差本身就是主标题，不要埋在摘要里
让观众产生单一强反应：居然如此、终于有人说、他说的是真的吗、原来中国优势在这里
大实话角度来自表达者身份与观点反差；言行反差角度必须有公开动作或披露支撑
涉及中国比较优势时，优先把外国企业被迫调整、海外权威改口或中国优势被低估写成冲突
avoid_patterns: 过长的新闻句，尤其是 24 字以上还塞多个从句
只有 策略/机会/影响/前瞻/市场/风险 这类泛词，没有具体对象或张力
美国宏观泛标题如果没有美联储/鲍威尔等强锚点，点击明显弱
纯描述式标题，例如 某市场短期风险与长期催化剂，缺少问题和冲突
经济危机/金融危机/崩盘/崩溃 这类过硬负面财经词
把事实换成疑问号但没有反差，例如 回报路径在哪、未来如何、能否实现
陌生英文人名或机构全称占据第一行，却没有告诉观众这个人为什么值得听
把 Bloomberg LP 等来源或公司法律后缀误当成采访对象
没有公开证据却暗示嘉宾撒谎、操纵或言行不一
